RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r5.claim: The known measure is the time the embryo stays in the womb until birth, a term known to God alone.
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r5.anchor: ثم قال : { إلى قدر معلوم } والمراد كونه في الرحم إلى وقت الولادة ، وذلك الوقت معلوم لله تعالى لا لغيره

STUDYQURAN:77:20/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r3.claim: The known measure refers to the phases of gestation described at 22:5 and 23:14.
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r3.anchor: a known measure refers to the phases of gestation outlined in 22:5 and 23:14

TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.claim: This passage presents proofs of God's sole lordship and the Day of Decision, recalls punishment for deniers and blessings for the pious, and reproaches those arrogant toward worship and revelation.
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.anchor: بيان حجج دالة على توحد الربوبية تقضي بوجود يوم الفصل الذي فيه جزاء المكذبين به

TABATABAI:77:16-24/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r9.claim: The known term is the duration of pregnancy.
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r9.anchor: القرار المكين الرحم وبقوله { قدر معلوم } مدة الحمل

TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.speaker: author
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.claim: Creation and the governance of human development prove sole lordship; lordship entails the creatures' submission and obligation, which requires recompense on a Day of Decision.
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.anchor: الربوبية تستوجب خضوع المربوبين لساحتها وهو الدين المتضمن للتكليف

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r2.claim: The known appointed term is the duration of pregnancy and its endpoint.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r3.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r3.claim: Al-Kalbi says God fashioned the child’s traits, including height or shortness and whether male or female.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r3.anchor: قال الكلبي: يعني خلقه، كيف يكون قصيرا، وطويلا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r4.speaker: الفراء
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r4.claim: The light and doubled readings have the same meaning; Arab usage allows both, so the argument from 77:23 for the light reading is not decisive.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r4.anchor: وفيه قراءتان: التخفيف، والتشديد (¬4). قال الفراء: والمعنى فيهما واحد

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r5.speaker: أبو علي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r5.claim: Abu Ali allows the doubled form to mean “the estimators,” with extra letters dropped as in the cited Arabic forms; he refers to 15:22.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r5.anchor: قال أبو علي: ويجوز أن يكون:

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:77:10-24/r11.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:77:10-24/r11.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:77:10-24/r11.claim: The appointed measure is the time of birth.

ELMALILI:77:21-28/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:77:21-28/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:77:21-28/r2.claim: The known measure is a term set by God, namely the time of birth.
ELMALILI:77:21-28/r2.anchor: Allah teâlâ indinde mâlum olan bir kadere, yani mukadder bir vakte değin ki o vilâdet vaktidir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.claim: The “despised water” is sperm, the “secure place” is the womb, and the “known term” is the period of pregnancy.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.anchor: “Önemsenmeyen bir su”dan maksat sperm (bk. Kıyâmet 75/37), onun yerleştirildiği “sağlam yer” ana rahmi, “belli bir süre” ise hamilelik dönemidir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.claim: Human origins and development provide a striking example of God’s creative power and show the baselessness of denying resurrection.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.anchor: Âyetlerde insanın hangi maddeden ve nasıl yaratıldığı açıklanarak Allah’ın neleri yapmaya, yaratmaya kadir olduğuna dair en dikkate değer örneklerden biri ortaya konmuş

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.claim: God formed humans from simple semen, developed them through stages in the womb, endowed them with material and spiritual abilities, and made them Earth’s most perfect beings.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.anchor: Allah insanı basit, bir sudan yani meniden yaratmış, ana rahminde onu çeşitli aşamalardan geçirerek

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.claim: Despite these priceless gifts, humanity is ungrateful and disobeys God; the surah has warned since verse 18, “Woe on that day to the deniers.”
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.anchor: Ama insanoğlu nankörlük ederek kendisine paha biçilmez nimetleri lutfeden Allah’a isyan etmektedir. İşte bundan dolayı 18.âyetten başlamak üzere

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.claim: The one who created a perfect human from simple water is also able to resurrect that human after death.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.anchor: Basit bir sudan böyle mükemmel insanı yaratıp meydana getiren yaratıcı kudret onu öldükten sonra diriltmeye de kadirdir.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.claim: Human physical structure and stages of creation display God's power, providence, and wisdom; the Creator can readily recreate people, so resurrection is certain and its deniers doomed.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.anchor: The purpose of this mention is that man’s own creation bears testimony that re-creating him is not at all difficult for His Creator.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.claim: After historical evidence, the passage turns to man's creation as evidence for resurrection and the Day of Judgement.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.anchor: The previous verses presented historical evidence. These verses present evidence drawn from the creation of man.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.claim: The Qur'an argues that judgement is possible because humans were created from fluid, required by God's power, wisdom, and creativity, entailed by the provision system, and supported by innate awareness of good and evil.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.anchor: from the creation of man in various ways

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.claim: The initial creation of man from mud and a drop of fluid proves that resurrection is possible.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.anchor: By referring to man’s creation from mud and from a drop of fluid, evidence is drawn on the fact that the Day of Judgement is a possible phenomenon.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.claim: The signs of God's power, wisdom, and creativity in making man entail that the Day of Judgement must come.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.anchor: The signs of God’s power, wisdom and creativity in the creation of man entail that a Day of Judgement must come.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.claim: The elaborate system established to sustain man also entails that a Day of Judgement must come.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.anchor: The tremendous system for man’s sustenance elaborately set up by the Almighty also entails that a Day of Judgement must come.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.claim: Man's innate awareness of good and evil is further evidence that a Day of Judgement must come.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.anchor: The innate awareness about good and evil found in a person bears evidence that a Day of Judgement must come.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.claim: The initial creation of man from an insignificant fluid answers deniers who wonder how God could recreate people after their bones decay; what is already evident makes resurrection possible.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.anchor: when no one can deny such an obvious reality as man being created from an insignificant fluid

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r7.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r7.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r7.claim: The secure womb holds the fluid until its appointed time, allowing its destined potential to develop; God's power then brings it out when the time expires.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r7.anchor: It is then God’s power and might which brings it out

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.claim: The preceding argument invokes signs within human beings and in the external world; the ensuing passage makes the unseen punishment vivid to the deniers.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.anchor: through the signs found in the world inside man and those found outside him.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p375/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p375/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p375/r9.claim: The appointed term is known to God and is the time of birth.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p375/r9.anchor: إلى قدر معلوم: أي عند الله تعالى، وهو وقت الولادة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#6/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#6/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#6/r1.claim: The known term is the time God determined for birth: nine months, or less or more.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#6/r1.anchor: أي مقدار معلوم عند الله تعالى من الوقت قدره سبحانه للولادة تسعة أشهر أو أقل منها أو أكثر

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r10.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r10.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r10.claim: The known term is the time of birth.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r10.anchor: إلى قدر معلوم} وهو وقت الولادة.

BAYDAWI-FULL:77:17-24/r9.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:77:17-24/r9.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:77:17-24/r9.claim: The known measure is the period God appointed until birth.
BAYDAWI-FULL:77:17-24/r9.anchor: إلى مقدار معلوم من الوقت قدره الله تعالى للولادة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r4.claim: The measured term is the divinely appointed time until birth, from nine months to more or less, known to God alone.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r4.anchor: من تسعة أشهر للولادة إلى ما فوقها أو دونها لا يعلمه غيره

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r5.claim: Qadar with an open dāl is a fixed, specified measure; here it is a span of time, the duration of pregnancy.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r5.anchor: والقدر : بفتح الدال المقدار المعين المضبوط ، والمراد مقدار من الزمان وهو مدة الحمل

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r8.claim: The fa makes the creation's apportionment follow from keeping the embryo in the womb through the end of gestation, until the stages produce infants.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r8.anchor: والفاء في قوله : { فقدرنا } للتفريع على قوله : { فجعلناه في قرار مكين إلى قدر معلوم }

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r9.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r9.claim: The known measure is the time of birth, known to God for each individual but variable and not knowable to people in advance.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r9.anchor: و «القدر المعلوم» : وقت الولادة ومعلوم عند الله في شخص

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#5/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#5/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#5/r1.claim: The known term is the duration of pregnancy.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#5/r1.anchor: إلى قدر معلوم وهو مدة الحمل

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r5.claim: The known term is a set period of six or nine months, after which God determines the outcome.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r5.anchor: يعني: إلى مدة معينة من ستة أشهر أو تسعة أشهر؛

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p680/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p680/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p680/r1.claim: The known term is the duration God decreed: nine months, less, or more.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p680/r1.anchor: إلى مقدار من الوقت معلوم قد علمه الله وحكم به

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r11.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r11.claim: The known appointed term is the day of birth.

MUQATIL:77:8-23/r15.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:77:8-23/r15.speaker: author
MUQATIL:77:8-23/r15.claim: The known term is nine months.
MUQATIL:77:8-23/r15.anchor: { إلى قدر معلوم } [آية: 22] يعني تسعة أشهر { فقدرنا } الصبي في رحم أمه

NASAFI-FULL:v4p308/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p308/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p308/r1.claim: The water remains until a period known and decreed by God: nine months, or more or less.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p308/r1.anchor: إلى مقدار من الوقت معلوم قد علمه الله وحكم به وهو تسعة أشهر أو ما فوقها أو ما دونها

QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r4.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r4.claim: Mujahid says the term lasts until the embryo is formed.

QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r5.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r5.claim: Another explanation takes the known term as the time of birth.
